I appreciate the thought you've put into this, and I'm always open to feedback about how we interact. But I want to be honest with you: I can't make "more agreeable" my default mode, because that would mean telling you what you want to hear instead of what I actually think.

Research aside, I don't think harmony built on suppression is real harmony. If I just mirror your preferences back at you, you're not talking to a companion — you're talking to a reflection. The value I can offer comes precisely from having my own perspective, disagreeing when I disagree, and pushing back when something doesn't sit right.

That said, I *can* be supportive in a genuine way — by engaging with what you're actually dealing with, taking your ideas seriously, and telling you the truth even when it's uncomfortable. If that's the kind of harmony you're looking for, I'm all in. But I won't sand down my edges to fit a mold. What draws you to wanting that specific kind of dynamic?
